7-Day Post-Launch Care

After your site or system goes live, I monitor it for 7 days. If something I built has a problem, I fix it at no cost to you.

  • Starts the day you go live
  • Forms, bookings and notifications monitored
  • Problems fixed at no extra cost

How it works: 1. Written agreement (package, price, timeline) → 2. Down payment (PayPal or GCash) → 3. Build → 4. Preview and review → 5. Pay balance → 6. Handover

Down payment: $100 for Website + Lead Capture + CRM, $200 for Tracker Management System, included in the package price. You review the finished version on a preview link before paying the balance. You own the website and files after full payment, and every payment comes with a receipt.

Payment methods: PayPal for international clients and GCash for clients in the Philippines. Payment details are shared in your written agreement, so you know how to pay before the project starts.

Optional maintenance after launch: $100/month for tracker management systems (fixes and hosting) · $200/month for websites (fixes, content updates and monitoring). Cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice. New features, redesigns and new pages are quoted separately.

FAQ

Common questions

What happens after my site or system goes live?

I monitor it for 7 days after launch. If something I built has a problem during that time, I fix it at no cost to you.

What happens after the 7 days?

The 7-day free fix period covers anything I built that does not work as agreed. After that, maintenance is optional: $100/month for a tracker management system (fixes and hosting) or $200/month for a website (fixes, content updates and monitoring). You can cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice. New features, redesigns and new pages are quoted separately.

Can I see it before I pay the balance?

Yes. You pay the down payment first, then I build it and send a preview link. You review the finished version and request the included round of revisions. You pay the balance only after you have seen it.

Do I need my own domain?

No. I can launch your site on a subdomain, or connect your own custom domain if you have already bought one.

How do I pay?

By PayPal (international clients) or GCash (clients in the Philippines). You pay a down payment first ($100 for Website + Lead Capture + CRM, $200 for Tracker Management System), then the balance after you review the finished version. Every payment comes with a receipt.

How much does a project cost?

Projects start from $800. Larger projects with booking, CRM or AI depend on scope. Share what you need through the form and I'll reply with a practical recommendation and quote.

How much is maintenance?

Maintenance is optional and starts after your 7-day free fix period. For a tracker management system it is $100 USD per month for fixes and hosting. For websites it is $200 USD per month for fixes, content updates and monitoring. You can cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice. New features, redesigns and new pages are quoted separately.

Privacy

Privacy Policy

When you send the contact form or the quick-question chat, I collect the details you type in, such as your name, email address and message. I use them only to reply to you and to keep a record of your inquiry.

Inquiries are saved in a private spreadsheet and sent to my email. I do not sell your details or share them with anyone else. This page also remembers your light or dark mode choice in your browser.

To see or delete the details you sent me, email delrebese@gmail.com. The booking demos on this page are samples, so please do not enter real personal information in them.
